# KeybindManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/KeybindManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

KeybindManager reads the keybinds the compositor has registered (CompositorManager.withBinds). Each bind's `description` is its label (on Hyprland's Lua config every action is an opaque `__lua` dispatcher). A "Section: Label" prefix picks the overlay section. Also the Keybinds page's editor for axiom's own binds (Keybinds.binds): a draft saved with save(), per-bind issues, presets, and recording a key combo (CompositorManager.captureKeys meanwhile, so the compositor's binds don't swallow the keys being recorded).

### Properties

- `keybindings` (readonly var): [{ title, undescribed, binds: [{ label, combos: [{ mods: ["SUPER", "SHIFT"], keys: ["H", "←"] }], axiom, user, ids, action, overrides }] }] `title` is "" for binds with no section (shown as "Other");…
- `count` (int): How many binds the compositor reported
- `query` (string): The Keybinds page's search and filter chips (KeybindFilter), here so they survive the page reloading: section keys (KeybindFilter.sectionKey), modifier names, sources ("axiom" | "user")
- `sectionFilter` (var)
- `modFilter` (var)
- `sourceFilter` (var)
- `filtering` (readonly bool)
- `modOptions` (readonly var): The modifier chips: the modifiers the binds use, in _modifiers order
- `editing` (bool): The Keybinds page shows the editor instead of the list
- `refView` (readonly string): How it's shown, remembered: "list" | "keyboard", "comfortable" | "compact", and modifiers as glyphs (⇧ ⌃ ⌥) or words
- `refDensity` (readonly string)
- `refGlyphs` (readonly bool)
- `refFolded` (readonly var): Folded modifier groups, by "<section key>|<mods>" (refGroupKey)
- `lookupIndex` (readonly int): A combo pressed to look up what it does ("SUPER + Q"), or "": recorded like a bind's key, into lookupIndex
- `lookupCombo` (string)
- `editQuery` (string): The editor's search, here so it survives the page reloading.
- `editSectionFilter` (var): The editor's chips: sections, modifier names, and binds with issues or paused ones (either, when both are on)
- `editModFilter` (var)
- `editIssuesOnly` (bool)
- `editPausedOnly` (bool)
- `editFiltering` (readonly bool)
- `reorderable` (readonly bool): Rows can be dragged into another order only while every bind shows
- `selectedIndex` (int): The bind the inspector edits, or -1 (the key map shows instead)
- `selectedBind` (readonly var)
- `revealIndex` (readonly int): The bind asked for, until its row has scrolled to it, or -1: a row built after the ask (the editor opening, a run unfolding) scrolls to itself when it's this one
- `expandedRuns` (var): Numbered runs shown bind by bind (BindGroups.runKey of their first bind -> true), for this session
- `binds` (readonly var): [{ key, action, argument, description }]
- `isDirty` (readonly alias)
- `actions` (readonly var)
- `actionLabels` (readonly var)
- `actionSections` (readonly var): The action picker's categories, in tab order ("" is All).
- `actionInfo` (readonly var): [{ action, label, section, icon }], one per action, in schema order The actions the running compositor can do (BindActions.needs); a saved bind with another keeps it, flagged in `issues`
- `editSectionOptions` (readonly var): The editor's chips: [{ key, title, count }] per section (actionSections order, then any others), and the modifiers its binds use
- `editModOptions` (readonly var)
- `visibleKey` (readonly string): The shown binds' indices, filtered by editQuery and the chips, in the saved order, joined: a string only notifies when it changes, so the rows survive edits that leave the list alone
- `pausedCount` (readonly int)
- `visibleIndices` (readonly var)
- `editLayout` (readonly var)
- `undoText` (readonly string): What Undo would take back, or ""
- `changedBinds` (readonly var): Per bind, whether it's new or differs from the bind it was when saved
- `userKeyCounts` (readonly var)
- `keyMapMods` (var): The modifiers the key map shows the keys under
- `issues` (readonly var): Per bind: [{ level: "error" | "warning" | "info", text }]; only errors and warnings are issues (issueCount, the issues filter, a row's border)
- `issueCount` (readonly int)
- `userConflicts` (readonly var): The binds on keys the user's compositor config binds too
- `canMerge` (readonly bool): Managed mode moves the user's binds into axiom instead of dropping axiom's (CompositorConfigManager.mergeUserBinds)
- `mergeableCount` (readonly int): How many binds in user/ a Merge would move (0 until looked at, when the page opens): not every bind there can (a Lua function, a shared module's, one in a submap), so it's not the conflict count
- `presets` (readonly var): [{ id, title, description, binds }], for the current workspace layout.
- `savedPresets` (readonly var): The saved presets (Keybinds.presets), shaped like the built-in ones: [{ id ("saved:" + its own), title, binds, saved }]
- `recordingIndex` (int): The bind whose key is being recorded, or -1

### Signals

- `revealRequested(int index)`: Asks the list to unfold and scroll to a bind, centred

### Functions

- `toggleFilter(group, value)`: group: "section" | "mod" | "source", or the editor's "editSection" | "editMod"
- `clearFilters()`
- `clearEditFilters()`
- `setRefView(value)`
- `setRefDensity(value)`
- `setRefGlyphs(value)`
- `refGroupKey(section, mods)`
- `toggleRefFold(key)`
- `selectBind(index, reveal)`: Selects a bind; the list scrolls to it unless `reveal` is false (a click on its own row, which shows already)
- `reveal(index)`
- `revealDone(index)`: A row has scrolled to bind `index`
- `editBind(index)`: Opens the editor on a bind (a click on it in the reference, the keyboard, a Cheatsheet), showing it even if the search or chips hid it
- `toggleRun(key)`
- `sectionIcon(title)`: Material Symbols per reference section, by title ("" is Other)
- `actionIcon(action)`
- `argumentKind(action)`: What an action's free-text argument is, for its placeholder
- `needsArgument(action)`
- `argumentOptions(action)`: The choices for an action's argument, or null for free text
- `callOptions(action)`: The choices for an action's call, or null when it has none
- `callLabels(action)`: A call's label for an action (a caffeine or night light bind turns it on or off, a recording bind starts or stops it)
- `ensureLoaded()`: Loads the draft unless it holds unsaved edits (the page is rebuilt whenever the overlay reopens)
- `save()`: Binds added, duplicated, merged or restored from a preset have no id of their own yet (or another's): each gets one as it's saved
- `reset()`
- `revertBind(index)`: Puts a bind back as it was saved, or removes it if it's new
- `undo()`
- `dismissUndo()`
- `addBind(bind)`: Adds a bind at the end and selects it.
- `addAndStartRecording(bind)`: Adds a bind and records its key
- `addAndRecord(bind)`: Adds `bind`, then opens the Keybinds page's editor recording its key (the layouts editor's Add a keybind)
- `duplicateBind(index)`: A copy of a bind after it, with no key yet, selected and recording
- `removeBind(index)`
- `moveBind(from, to)`: Moves a bind to `to` (its index after the move)
- `setPaused(indices, on)`: Pauses or resumes binds (a section's, a run's, one)
- `setField(index, field, value)`
- `toggleKeyMapMod(mod)`
- `bindLabel(bind)`: A bind's label: its own (less a "Section:" prefix), else its action's
- `bindIndexFor(ids)`: The first of the editor's binds (not paused) on one of `ids` (a reference row's keys), or -1
- `hasIssue(found)`: Whether a bind's `issues` hold an error or warning, not only notes
- `removeUserConflicts()`: Removes every bind on a key the user's compositor config binds too (until Save, like any edit).
- `mergeUserBinds()`
- `presetPlan(id)`: What a preset would do, bind by bind: [{ bind, id (its key's BindKeys.keyId), status, takenBy, chosen }].
- `applyPreset(id, ids)`: Applies a preset's binds whose keys (BindKeys.keyId) are in `ids`: new ones at the end, taken ones after the binds on their key, which pause.
- `restorePreset(id)`: Puts a saved preset's binds in place of all of them (an unsaved edit, like any other)
- `savePreset(name)`: Saves the binds as they are in the editor (unsaved edits too) as a preset, in place of the one by that name if there is one.
- `renamePreset(id, name)`
- `deletePreset(id)`
- `startRecording(index)`: Meanwhile every key reaches the recorder instead of a bind (CompositorManager.captureKeys)
- `finishRecording(combo)`
- `stopRecording()`
- `refresh()`
- `refreshSoon()`: After binds were applied at runtime, which no compositor announces
- `displayCombo(combo)`: A combo as shown on the page ("SUPER + mouse:272" -> "SUPER + LMB")
- `displayKey(key)`: A key name as shown on a keycap ("space" -> "Space", "left" -> "←")
